title: headquarters — highlight

sentences.sentence: the headquarters of the United Nations
sentences.translation: 联合国总部

translations.translation: 用树篱笆围住；避免作正面答复
对冲，套期保值；树篱；障碍

sentences.sentence: You’re hedging again - have you got the money or haven’t you?
sentences.translation: 你又在闪烁其词了，你究竟有没有钱？

sentences.sentence: ‘That depends on my partner,’ she hedged.
sentences.translation: “那取决于我的合伙人。”她避重就轻地答道。

sentences.sentence: So she went in search of her hedgehog.
sentences.translation: 因此她就走了，找她的刺猬去了。

sentences.sentence: Even though it might look like a porcupine, the hedgehog eats insects and small animals while the porcupine is a vegetarian.
sentences.translation: 尽管它看上去可能象一只豪猪，然而刺猬是个素食动物，它只吃昆虫和小动物。

sentences.sentence: The hedgehog only comes out at night to scurry around for a meal.
sentences.translation: 刺猬只在夜间出来，到处匆匆地转，找寻食物。

sentences.sentence: If she had only heeded my warnings , none of this would have happened.
sentences.translation: 要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。

sentences.sentence: Gather the right crew: You’ll need the right partners in crime to pull the heist.
sentences.translation: 召集合适的搭档： 你将需要一些合适的正在犯罪的搭档去抢劫。

sentences.sentence: It had not been much of a heist; he said his accomplice “got some change” but he got nothing.
sentences.translation: 那都说不上是一次抢劫，他说他的同谋“搞了点零钱”而他一无所获。

sentences.sentence: Angelina plays Gloria, a young girl whose brother was killed in the heist-gone-wrong.
sentences.translation: 安吉丽娜饰演格罗瑞亚，她的哥哥在那次抢劫中被误杀。

sentences.sentence: You can helicopter to the island.
sentences.translation: 你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。

sentences.sentence: The helicopter is staying over our heads.
sentences.translation: 那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。

sentences.sentence: They were succoured from the fire by the rescue helicopter.
sentences.translation: 他们被援救的直升机从大火中解救了出来。

sentences.sentence: We have a helium nucleus and one electron.
sentences.translation: 我们有一个氦核和一个电子。

sentences.sentence: If helium loses on electron, what do we have?
sentences.translation: 如果氦原子失去了一个电子，我们得到了什么？

translations.translation: [生化] 血红蛋白（等于haemoglobin）；血红素

sentences.sentence: Please wait for the result of your hemoglobin test.
sentences.translation: 请等一下你的血红蛋白化验结果。

sentences.sentence: Some, like hemoglobin, deliver oxygen from the lungs to the far reaches of the body.
sentences.translation: 有些蛋白质像血红蛋白一样，可以把氧从肺部输送到身体各处。

sentences.sentence: Usually, if you or I or any nonadapted person went to high altitude, we would increase our hemoglobin levels to compensate for the low amount of oxygen.
sentences.translation: 通常，如果你、我或其他任何不适应的人去了高海拔地区，就会使体内血红蛋白的水平增高，以弥补那里低的氧气量。

sentences.sentence: But water containing the herbicide cannot be released back into the river and it is known that low water levels can harm river ecosystems accustomed to higher levels.
sentences.translation: 但含有除草剂的水不能再排向河流，而且我们知道低水位将会对习惯于高水位的河流生态系统造成危害。

sentences.sentence: Genetically altered soybeans and cotton require less herbicide to control weeds. These varieties now make up more than 70 percent of all soybean and cotton acreage planted in the United States.
sentences.translation: 转基因的大豆和棉花不需要那么多除草剂来控制杂草，这些品种现在占美国大豆和棉花种植面积的70%以上。

sentences.sentence: Virtually all commercial GMOs are bred to withstand direct application of herbicide and/or to produce an insecticide.
sentences.translation: 事实上，所有的商业性的转基因生物都可以抵抗直接作用的除草剂和/或者制造一种杀虫剂。

sentences.sentence: The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible , smellwise.
sentences.translation: 相对地，食草动物的肉闻起来要好些，更易食用。

sentences.sentence: You probably would call me a vegetarian. But scientists call me a herbivore because I only eat leaves, grass and other plants.
sentences.translation: 可能你会说我是素食者，但科学家称我为草食动物，因为我只吃叶子、草和其它植物。

phrases.translation: 羊群行为；羊群效应；从众行为；群体恐慌行为

sentences.sentence: You have to be an individual; it’s no use running with the herd.
sentences.translation: 你必须特立独行，随大溜没有用处。

translations.translation: 遗传的；世袭的；世代相传的

sentences.sentence: a hereditary peer
sentences.translation: 世袭贵族

sentences.sentence: I made the then heretical suggestion that it might be cheaper to design new machines.
sentences.translation: 我提出了当时被当做旁门左道的建议，说设计新机器或许更省钱。

translations.translation: 遗产；传统；继承物；继承权

phrases.translation: 传统基金会；遗产基金会

sentences.sentence: the importance of preserving the national heritage
sentences.translation: 保护民族遗产的重要性

sentences.sentence: beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
sentences.translation: 属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

sentences.sentence: Instead it is the Desert Express that pulls in, its nine coaches in smart blue, orange and white livery with large hexagonal windows.
sentences.translation: 然而驶进车站的是沙漠快车，它的九节车厢漆成漂亮的蓝色、橙色和白色，带有六边形的车窗。

sentences.sentence: He has instead looked to the hexagonal matrices of snowflakes, which as structurally supported objects combine high volume with low weight.
sentences.translation: 他期望使用雪花的六角形矩阵造型来作为支撑，因为这种结构做到了低重量与大容量的统一。

sentences.sentence: In fact, I have kept a souvenir of those days: a dark green hexagonal glass spittoon that is now a very original flowerpot.
sentences.translation: 说真的，我还保存了一个那个时代的纪念品--一个深绿色六角形的玻璃痰盂，如今，它成为了我的一个很别致的花盆。

sentences.sentence: She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
sentences.translation: 她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

phrases.translation: 等级结构，分层结构；层次组织

sentences.sentence: ...the traditional hierarchical system of military organization.
sentences.translation: …军事组织内的传统等级制度。

phrases.translation: 继承层次；继承体系；继承阶层架构
需要层次；需求层次理论
需要层次理论；需要阶梯理论
对象阶层架构；对象层次结构

sentences.sentence: a rigid social hierarchy
sentences.translation: 严格的社会等级制度

sentences.sentence: She worked her way up through the corporate hierarchy to become president.
sentences.translation: 她在公司一步一步升到了总裁的位置。

translations.translation: 象形文字；象形文字写的文章

sentences.sentence: The Inca had no system of hieroglyphic writing, as the Maya did, and any portraits that Inca artists may have made of their rulers were lost.
sentences.translation: 和玛雅人一样，印加人也没有象形文字书写系统，而且印加艺术家们所绘制的统治者肖像业已失传。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 66 单元

headquarters
音标：英 /hed'kwɔːtəz/  美 /'hɛdkwɔrtɚz/
n. 总部；指挥部；司令部
短语：general headquarters — 陆军总司令部
例句：the headquarters of the United Nations
联合国总部

hedge
音标：英 /hedʒ/  美 /hɛdʒ/
v. 用树篱笆围住；避免作正面答复
n. 对冲，套期保值；树篱；障碍
短语：hedge fund — 避险基金；套保基金
短语：hedge against — 避免损失的措施
短语：hedge against inflation — [经]为防通货膨胀而套购
例句：You’re hedging again - have you got the money or haven’t you?
你又在闪烁其词了，你究竟有没有钱？
例句：‘That depends on my partner,’ she hedged.
“那取决于我的合伙人。”她避重就轻地答道。

hedgehog
音标：英 /'hedʒ(h)ɒg/  美 /'hɛdʒhɔɡ/
n. 刺猬
例句：So she went in search of her hedgehog.
因此她就走了，找她的刺猬去了。
例句：Even though it might look like a porcupine, the hedgehog eats insects and small animals while the porcupine is a vegetarian.
尽管它看上去可能象一只豪猪，然而刺猬是个素食动物，它只吃昆虫和小动物。
例句：The hedgehog only comes out at night to scurry around for a meal.
刺猬只在夜间出来，到处匆匆地转，找寻食物。

heed
音标：英 /hiːd/  美 /hid/
v. 注意，留心
n. 注意到；留心到
例句：If she had only heeded my warnings , none of this would have happened.
要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。

heist
音标：英 /haɪst/  美 /haist/
v. 抢劫，拦劫；强夺
n. 抢劫；强夺
例句：Gather the right crew: You’ll need the right partners in crime to pull the heist.
召集合适的搭档： 你将需要一些合适的正在犯罪的搭档去抢劫。
例句：It had not been much of a heist; he said his accomplice “got some change” but he got nothing.
那都说不上是一次抢劫，他说他的同谋“搞了点零钱”而他一无所获。
例句：Angelina plays Gloria, a young girl whose brother was killed in the heist-gone-wrong.
安吉丽娜饰演格罗瑞亚，她的哥哥在那次抢劫中被误杀。

helicopter
音标：英 /'helɪkɒptə/  美 /'hɛlɪkɑptɚ/
n. [航] 直升飞机
vi. [航] 乘直升飞机
vt. 由直升机运送
例句：You can helicopter to the island.
你可以乘坐直升机去那个岛。
例句：The helicopter is staying over our heads.
那架直升机就在我们头顶的上方。
例句：They were succoured from the fire by the rescue helicopter.
他们被援救的直升机从大火中解救了出来。

helium
音标：英 /'hiːlɪəm/  美 /'hilɪəm/
n. [化学] 氦（符号为He，2号元素）
短语：liquid helium — 液氦；液态氦
短语：helium gas — 氦气
例句：We have a helium nucleus and one electron.
我们有一个氦核和一个电子。
例句：If helium loses on electron, what do we have?
如果氦原子失去了一个电子，我们得到了什么？

hemoglobin
音标：英 /,hiːməʊ'ɡləʊbɪn/  美 /,hɛmo'ɡlobɪn/
n. [生化] 血红蛋白（等于haemoglobin）；血红素
例句：Please wait for the result of your hemoglobin test.
请等一下你的血红蛋白化验结果。
例句：Some, like hemoglobin, deliver oxygen from the lungs to the far reaches of the body.
有些蛋白质像血红蛋白一样，可以把氧从肺部输送到身体各处。
例句：Usually, if you or I or any nonadapted person went to high altitude, we would increase our hemoglobin levels to compensate for the low amount of oxygen.
通常，如果你、我或其他任何不适应的人去了高海拔地区，就会使体内血红蛋白的水平增高，以弥补那里低的氧气量。

herbicide
音标：英 /'hɜːbɪsaɪd/  美 /'ɝbɪsaɪd/
n. [农药] 除草剂
例句：But water containing the herbicide cannot be released back into the river and it is known that low water levels can harm river ecosystems accustomed to higher levels.
但含有除草剂的水不能再排向河流，而且我们知道低水位将会对习惯于高水位的河流生态系统造成危害。
例句：Genetically altered soybeans and cotton require less herbicide to control weeds. These varieties now make up more than 70 percent of all soybean and cotton acreage planted in the United States.
转基因的大豆和棉花不需要那么多除草剂来控制杂草，这些品种现在占美国大豆和棉花种植面积的70%以上。
例句：Virtually all commercial GMOs are bred to withstand direct application of herbicide and/or to produce an insecticide.
事实上，所有的商业性的转基因生物都可以抵抗直接作用的除草剂和/或者制造一种杀虫剂。

herbivore
音标：英 /'hɜːbɪvɔː/  美 /ɝ​bəˌvɔr/
n. [动] 食草动物
例句：The meat of the herbivore is, in comparison, far more edible , smellwise.
相对地，食草动物的肉闻起来要好些，更易食用。
例句：You probably would call me a vegetarian. But scientists call me a herbivore because I only eat leaves, grass and other plants.
可能你会说我是素食者，但科学家称我为草食动物，因为我只吃叶子、草和其它植物。

herd
音标：英 /hɜːd/  美 /hɝd/
n. 兽群，畜群；放牧人
v. 成群，聚在一起
短语：a herd of — 一群（牛、鹿等）
短语：herd behavior — 羊群行为；羊群效应；从众行为；群体恐慌行为
短语：herd instinct — [心]群居本能，群体心理
例句：You have to be an individual; it’s no use running with the herd.
你必须特立独行，随大溜没有用处。

hereditary
音标：英 /hɪ'redɪt(ə)rɪ/  美 /hə'rɛdə'tɛri/
adj. 遗传的；世袭的；世代相传的
n. 遗传类
短语：hereditary disease — [医]遗传性疾病
短语：hereditary factor — 遗传因子；遗传因素
例句：a hereditary peer
世袭贵族

heretical
音标：英 /hɪ'retɪk(ə)l/  美 /həˈrɛtɪkəl/
adj. 异端的；异教的
例句：I made the then heretical suggestion that it might be cheaper to design new machines.
我提出了当时被当做旁门左道的建议，说设计新机器或许更省钱。

heritage
音标：英 /'herɪtɪdʒ/  美 /'hɛrɪtɪdʒ/
n. 遗产；传统；继承物；继承权
短语：cultural heritage — 文化遗产
短语：natural heritage — 自然遗产
短语：heritage preservation — 遗产维护
短语：heritage foundation — 传统基金会；遗产基金会
例句：the importance of preserving the national heritage
保护民族遗产的重要性
例句：beautiful old buildings which are part of our heritage
属于我们遗产一部分的漂亮古建筑

hexagonal
音标：英 /hek'sæɡənəl/  美 /hɛk'sægənl/
adj. 六边的，六角形的
短语：hexagonal system — 六方晶系，六角晶系
短语：hexagonal nut — 六角螺母
例句：Instead it is the Desert Express that pulls in, its nine coaches in smart blue, orange and white livery with large hexagonal windows.
然而驶进车站的是沙漠快车，它的九节车厢漆成漂亮的蓝色、橙色和白色，带有六边形的车窗。
例句：He has instead looked to the hexagonal matrices of snowflakes, which as structurally supported objects combine high volume with low weight.
他期望使用雪花的六角形矩阵造型来作为支撑，因为这种结构做到了低重量与大容量的统一。
例句：In fact, I have kept a souvenir of those days: a dark green hexagonal glass spittoon that is now a very original flowerpot.
说真的，我还保存了一个那个时代的纪念品--一个深绿色六角形的玻璃痰盂，如今，它成为了我的一个很别致的花盆。

hide
音标：英 /haɪd/  美 /haɪd/
v. 隐藏；隐瞒；鞭打
n. 躲藏；兽皮；躲藏处
短语：hide from — 隐瞒
短语：hide and seek — 捉迷藏
短语：cattle hide — 牛皮
短语：hide all — 全部隐藏
短语：hide away — 把……隐藏
短语：raw hide — [化]生皮；血光皮
短语：hide out — 躲藏
例句：She keeps a bottle of gin hidden behind a stack of books.
她在一堆书的后面藏了一瓶杜松子酒。

hierarchical
音标：英 /haɪə'rɑːkɪk(ə)l/  美 /,haɪə'rɑrkɪkl/
adj. 分层的；等级体系的
短语：hierarchical structure — 分级结构，层级结构
短语：hierarchical clustering — 分级群聚
短语：hierarchical model — 分层模型；层级模型
短语：hierarchical control — 分级控制；阶层控制
短语：hierarchical cluster analysis — 层序聚类分析
短语：hierarchical network — [计]分级网络；阶层式网路
短语：hierarchical organization — 等级结构，分层结构；层次组织
短语：hierarchical design — 分层设计
短语：hierarchical planning — 分级规划；递阶规划
例句：...the traditional hierarchical system of military organization.
…军事组织内的传统等级制度。

hierarchy
音标：英 /'haɪərɑːkɪ/  美 /'haɪərɑrki/
n. 层级；等级制度
短语：social hierarchy — 社会等级；社会阶层
短语：hierarchy system — 体系；分级系统
短语：inheritance hierarchy — 继承层次；继承体系；继承阶层架构
短语：hierarchy of needs — 需要层次；需求层次理论
短语：knowledge hierarchy — 知识体系
短语：hierarchy of needs theory — 需要层次理论；需要阶梯理论
短语：object hierarchy — 对象阶层架构；对象层次结构
短语：feudal hierarchy — 封建等级制度
例句：a rigid social hierarchy
严格的社会等级制度
例句：She worked her way up through the corporate hierarchy to become president.
她在公司一步一步升到了总裁的位置。

hieroglyphic
音标：英 /haɪrə'glɪfɪk/  美 /,haɪərə'glɪfɪk/
n. 象形文字；象形文字写的文章
adj. 象形文字的；难解的
例句：The Inca had no system of hieroglyphic writing, as the Maya did, and any portraits that Inca artists may have made of their rulers were lost.
和玛雅人一样，印加人也没有象形文字书写系统，而且印加艺术家们所绘制的统治者肖像业已失传。

highlight
音标：英 /'haɪlaɪt/  美 /'haɪlaɪt/
v. 突出；强调；使显著；加亮
n. 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；加亮区
例句：Your résumé should highlight your skills and achievements.
你的简历应该突出自己的技能和成绩。
